name: Crossover
idea: Dribble one way until your defender follows, then switch hands and go the other way.
why: Your defender slides with you, so they lean the way you're going. A quick crossover bounces the ball low across your body to the other hand, and before they can stop and turn around, you're past them.
tryit: Dribble to the right, then push the ball low and hard across your body to your left hand, and step left at the same time. Practice slowly first, then faster.

frames.say: {1} is dribbling at the top, with the ball in the right hand. {X1} is guarding.
{1} dribbles to the right, and {X1} slides right along.
*Crossover:* {1} bounces the ball across to the left hand and cuts back the other way. {X1} is still leaning right!
{1} drives past {X1}, straight to the basket.
Layup! Make your defender go one way, then cross over and go the other way.
